description: Synthetic datasets for the COSC 520 mergeable-heap benchmark

keys.format: gzip-compressed text, one integer per line

graph.format: gzip-compressed text: header '# vertices=V edges=E', then one 'source target weight' line per edge, grouped by source
graph.construction: random Hamiltonian path from vertex 0 (V - 1 edges) plus uniformly random edges between distinct vertices
